content.text: Since `neofetch` is not installed on this Windows Bash environment, let me display a custom neofetch-style output showing system info.

input.command:
powershell.exe -Command "
Write-Host '+' -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host '| -neofetch-' -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host '| - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -' -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host '+ - System - ' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host '+ - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$os = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Caption)
$version = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty BuildNumber)
$arch = (Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Architecture).replace('x64-based processor', 'x86_64')
Write-Host '| OS                       | ' -ForegroundColor Cyan -NoNewline
Write-Host $os -ForegroundColor Gray
$host.UI.RawUI.WriteHost '+' -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor Cyan -NoNewline
Write-Host ' - ' -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor White -NoNewline
Write-Host (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty BuildNumber) -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor White
Write-Host '| Architecture              | ' -ForegroundColor Cyan -NoNewline
Write-Host $arch.Replace('x86_64', 'x86_64') -ForegroundColor Gray
$host.UI.RawUI.WriteHost '+' -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor Cyan -NoNewline
Write-Host '' -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor White -NoNewline
Write-Host '| Kernel                    | ' -ForegroundColor Cyan -NoNewline
Write-Host (Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty SystemType) -ForegroundColor Gray
$host.UI.RawUI.WriteHost '+' -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor Cyan -NoNewline
Write-Host ' - ' -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor White -NoNewline
Write-Host (Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object -First1).ComputerSystem.SystemType -ForegroundColor Black -BackgroundColor White
"
